headline: IKIO Technologies subsidiary signs vendor exclusivity undertaking
hook: Vendor pact signed by step-down unit
summary: IKIO Technologies has announced that its step-down subsidiary has executed a vendor exclusivity undertaking. The disclosure was made to the stock exchange under Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR Regulations. Specific financial details and the identity of the vendor partner were not provided in the brief exchange filing. Retail investors should note this is a procedural corporate update without immediate financial impact figures.
why_it_matters: Subsidiary vendor pact brings no immediate financial impact.

headline: IKIO Technologies files SEBI compliance certificate on dematerialized securities
hook: Routine regulatory filing by IKIO Technologies
summary: IKIO Technologies has submitted its required SEBI compliance certificate regarding dematerialized securities. The filing confirms adherence to depository participant regulations for the relevant period. Such procedural disclosures are standard regulatory requirements for listed Indian companies. The filing carries no direct operational or financial impact for retail investors.
why_it_matters: No direct financial impact on your portfolio.
